manifest.name: STARBOX COFFEE: Coffee Rising
manifest.description: CLIMB. COLLECT. BREW. Choose Milo or Mira, explore a warm glass-mug cafe and jump through wooden ledges, switchbacks and crumbling biscuits. Collect Espresso or Latte recipes, outrun rising coffee and earn Perfect Coffee cards. Free arcade play.
